listing.name: Dark Souls: Remastered — Switch edition (lordran-native)
listing.summary: An experimental Apple port of the Switch edition of Dark Souls: Remastered. Build locally on an Apple silicon Mac with your own base game and 1.0.3 update. The iOS download is an unsigned build component. Windows tools only package Apple output.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use both the base NSP and the 1.0.3 update NSP, v196608, for title 01004AB00A260000, plus prod.keys. Both packages are needed to prepare shaders even for the base version.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use Xcode on an Apple silicon Mac with the matching project source and shell. The iOS build targets version 26 or later. The ZIP still needs a build and signing before installation.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project has not confirmed Mac graphics or device compatibility. It specifies no separate firmware input.
